name: knowledgebase-mcp
description: Read, search, and write an Obsidian vault over the Local REST API plugin.

obsidian_api_key.title: Obsidian API key
obsidian_api_key.description: From the Local REST API plugin's settings in Obsidian. Grants read, write, and delete over the whole vault, and is stored in the OS credential store rather than settings.json.

knowledgebase_read_only.title: Read-only mode
knowledgebase_read_only.description: Disables every write, including write_note. Leave this on unless you want the agent to be able to modify notes.
